summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file after track(), Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file after Progress.track(), and a private _make_read_progress helper); tests/test_progress.py (13 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759). Choices beyond the spec: Progress.open has a third overload taking a plain str mode, so the module-level open can call it type-correctly; the reader's write raises io.UnsupportedOperation with a message naming 'write'. Unverified: tests, mypy, and black were not run, so the readinto signature line may exceed 88 characters and the type-ignore placement and Python 3.6 base-class combination are unconfirmed.
